title: The Hollow Hollow Revisited
author: Ulyana Halloran
blurb: Ulyana Dunmore, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
